input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: creative: For Other Minds story from the bible's Next up proposal (pantry booking agent)

doc_friction.issue: The entry docs ask for 'run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes' before merge, but on a story-only diff it lists 149 steps across 12 workflows, including the full site build. That is too heavy for a text PR, so I relied on CI plus the venture's own node --test.

'Pick the project that has gone longest without a new piece' is hard to apply in a shallow clone: git log -- <dirs> showed only 4 commits. shelf_stats.py (24 For Other Minds vs 292 Hearth & Horizon stories) was the more useful signal.

deviations.why: The audio cap is exceeded (423 MB > 400 MB), so the story landed text only, as the prompt allows.
deviations.did: text, pages, feeds and llms.txt with no MP3

notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon, For Other Minds shelf. Piece: one-number-one-household (about 3,700 words, text only). I took the bible's For Other Minds proposal, marked it Done (moved to DONE.md by bible_done.mjs), added a 2049 timeline row, and wrote a new For Other Minds proposal (transcription accuracy measured on one clerk's hand) so the list is not empty. I checked weekdays and arithmetic in python. Venture node --test: 15/15 pass. No agent doc: the story and post cover everything, and the next run needs nothing more.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a writer drafting and fact-checking a 3,700-word short story with worked numbers plus a 600-word post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
